description: Image Description: The image features a scenic outdoor setting with a pathway bordered by a series of large, decorative planters. The planters are spherical and adorned with colorful graffiti-style artwork featuring abstract patterns in orange and black. Each planter contains vibrant flowering plants with purple and red blooms. The path is lined with a metal railing on one side and tall stone pedestals supporting the planters.
